when.quote: Procedure for opening personal savings accounts.

starts.note: Start only when the customer asks to open a savings account. Once the account is open, offer the opening-deposit transfer, because the document says to.
starts.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

info.about: Any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number and address, checked against the records
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you please give me two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: Which checking account the customer wants to close and which one they want to keep
info.ask: Which checking account would you like to close, and which one would you like to keep?

info.about: How many withdrawals per month the customer expects to make from savings
info.ask: About how many withdrawals or transfers out of savings do you expect to make each month?

info.about: The balance the customer can realistically keep in savings. Compare it with each account's minimum opening deposit and ongoing minimum balance.
info.ask: Roughly how much can you keep in the savings account on an ongoing basis?

info.about: The features the customer wants, such as a relationship or loyalty APY bonus, daily compounding, ATM fee rebates, built-in savings goals tracking, eco features or a premium tier
info.ask: Are there any features that matter to you, such as how interest compounds, ATM fee rebates, a bonus for existing customers, or tools for tracking savings goals?

info.about: The minimum APY the customer wants at the balance they will keep
info.ask: Is there a minimum interest rate (APY) you're aiming for?

info.ask: Would you like me to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account now?

info.about: The savings account the customer chose, either earlier in the conversation (for example, from the card + savings recommendation) or after the recommendation, as a full official name ending with 'Account'
info.ask: Which savings account would you like me to open?

info.about: How much to move from checking now, if the customer funds the account now. It may be more than the minimum opening deposit (for example, the whole planned deposit).
info.ask: How much would you like me to transfer into the new savings account?

steps.do: Find the customer's record by the name, email or user id they give.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gives (or use get_user_information_by_email / get_user_information_by_id)

steps.if: the customer has not already been verified in this conversation
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Confirm that the customer correctly gives 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address. Share no account information before this.
steps.if: the customer has not already been verified in this conversation
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log and for checking account age.
steps.quote: The customer’s checking account tenure is at least 14 days.

steps.do: Log the verification record.
steps.if: the customer has not already been verified and logged in this conversation
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.if: the tool is not already unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get all of the customer's bank accounts (status, balance, class, date_opened). Read them again even if you read them earlier, because an account may have just been opened.
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Work out each checking account's tenure from the current time and its date_opened. If the account the customer wants to close is the only active checking account open at least 14 days, open the savings account BEFORE closing it. Explain why without exposing internal tool details: savings needs an active checking account held at least 14 days, and the remaining one is too new. If the customer pushes back or asks to close first, give this reason again; do not just insist.
steps.if: the customer wants both to close a checking account and to open savings
steps.quote: Confirm an active checking account exists and meets the 14-day tenure requirement.

steps.do: If the customer wants the balance of an account being closed moved into the new savings account, open the savings account first so the destination exists and is OPEN. Then run the closure job.
steps.if: the customer wants funds from an account being closed moved into the savings account being opened
steps.quote: - Confirm both the source and destination accounts are in ACTIVE or OPEN status

steps.do: Check every eligibility item. (1) An active checking account held at least 14 days; one opened in this conversation does not count, but an older active checking account does. (2) Fewer than 5 personal savings accounts. (3) No account in collections and none with a negative balance. If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, tell them they have reached the maximum and stop. If any account is in collections or negative, tell them it must be resolved first and stop.
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: Explain that a personal savings account requires an active Rho-Bank checking account. Do not open the savings account, and stop.
steps.if: get_accounts shows no active checking account
steps.quote: Customer has at least one active Rho-Bank checking account.

steps.do: Tell the customer the date they become eligible: 14 days after the earliest active checking account's date_opened. Do not open the account.
steps.if: no active checking account has at least 14 days of tenure
steps.quote: Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

steps.do: If the customer already accepted a savings account earlier in this conversation (for example, from recommend_credit_card_and_savings_combination, which now also covers recommend_credit_card_and_savings_account_combination, recommend_savings_account_and_credit_card_combination and the no-card checking + savings pairing), skip gather_needs and recommend. Go straight to confirm_class with that account's full official name (e.g. 'Gold Plus Account').
steps.if: the customer is eligible and already accepted a savings account recommended earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Before recommending anything, ask about the customer's savings needs: withdrawals per month, the balance they can keep and their maximum, compounding, ATM rebates, relationship bonus, minimum APY and goals tracking.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit cards. An EcoCard raises the Green Account (savings) free withdrawals to 15 and adds $20 in ATM rebates. A Gold Rewards Card lowers the Gold Account minimum to $5,000 and adds its relationship bonus.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Gold Account holders who also have a Gold Rewards Card receive exclusive benefits that make the account more accessible.

steps.do: Compare every personal savings account against the customer's needs and recommend ONE that meets all of them, applying card-holder benefits only when get_credit_cards shows the card. Exclude any account that fails a need: its opening deposit or ongoing minimum is above the customer's maximum; its free withdrawals are below the customer's monthly count; it lacks ATM rebates the customer needs; or its APY at the customer's balance is below their target. Only Silver Plus Account matches 12–15 withdrawals a month, a relationship bonus, a $2,500–$4,000 balance with nothing near $10,000, daily compounding, ATM fee rebates and savings goals tracking. It is also the only match for frequent withdrawals (3–4 a week), a $5,000–$7,000 balance, daily compounding, ATM rebates and at least 3% APY: its Tier 1 rate is 3.0% below $15,000, and Gold needs $10,000. Eco and premium requests are side wishes that don't fit the hard needs. If the customer asks for one answer, give one. Mention the $1,000 opening deposit, the $2,500 minimum balance and the $8.00 fee charged below it.
steps.if: the customer has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

steps.do: Confirm the chosen account_class with the customer, using the full official name ending with 'Account' (e.g. 'Silver Plus Account').
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Unlock the account opening tool.
steps.if: the tool is not already unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Open the savings account.

arguments.account_class: the confirmed account class, e.g. 'Silver Plus Account'

steps.if: all eligibility checks passed and the customer confirmed the account_class
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Tell the customer the account could not be opened and why. Do not retry with different values unless the customer confirms them. If a system error blocks the opening, offer a human agent and transfer only if the customer agrees, using reason technical_system_error.

args.summary: the opening attempt and the error returned

steps.if: open_bank_account_4821 returned a system error that cannot be resolved and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request

steps.do: Ask whether the customer wants the opening deposit transferred from checking now.
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: If the customer wants a transfer but no OPEN checking account in get_accounts has enough balance to cover even the opening deposit (for example the old checking was already emptied), say a transfer cannot be made now and go to funding_deadline. Do not attempt the transfer.
steps.if: the customer says yes but no OPEN checking account's balance covers the opening deposit
steps.quote: Verify the source account has sufficient available funds to cover the transfer amount

steps.do: Confirm the amount to move. It is at least the account's minimum opening deposit; if the customer asks to move more (for example the whole amount they planned to deposit), use the amount they state. Confirm the source checking account.
steps.if: the customer says yes
steps.quote: Moving funds between accounts at customer request

steps.do: Read the accounts again to get the new savings account_id and the current checking balance.
steps.if: the customer says yes and open_savings did not return the new account id, or the checking balance may have changed
steps.quote: Verify the source account has sufficient available funds to cover the transfer amount

steps.do: Before transferring, confirm that the source checking account and the new savings account are both ACTIVE/OPEN and that the source balance covers the amount. If not, offer a different amount or source account.
steps.if: the customer says yes
steps.quote: - Verify the source account has sufficient available funds to cover the transfer amount

steps.do: Unlock and call transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to move the confirmed amount from an OPEN checking account with enough funds to the new savings account. On an insufficient-funds error, offer to adjust the amount or use another source account.

arguments.amount: the amount confirmed in confirm_amount (the required opening deposit, or the larger amount the customer asked to move)

steps.if: the customer says yes
steps.quote: If yes: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount from the customer’s checking account to the newly opened savings account.

steps.do: Tell the customer the transfer did not go through. On insufficient funds, re-check the funds and offer to adjust the amount or use another source account. If they do not fund now, give the 30-day funding deadline.
steps.if: transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 returned an error
steps.quote: Offer to adjust the amount or select a different source account after re-validating available funds

steps.do: Tell the customer they have 30 days to fund the account by internal transfer or external deposit (such as depositing a check themselves), or it will be closed. Mention the account's opening deposit minimum (e.g. Gold Plus Account $10,000, Gold Account $5,000, Silver Plus Account $1,000, Green Account (savings) $100).
steps.if: the customer declines the transfer, or empty_source found no account able to fund it
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

steps.do: Along with the funding deadline, tell the customer the Platinum Plus Account needs $50,000 to open and $100,000 kept ongoing, and that a $50.00 monthly fee applies below $100,000.
steps.if: the opened account_class is 'Platinum Plus Account' and the customer will fund it later
steps.quote: Initial deposit to open: $50,000

steps.do: If the amount in the new account is below its ongoing minimum balance, tell the customer the monthly fee that applies (e.g. Gold Account: $10.00 per month below $10,000; Silver Plus: $8.00 below $2,500; Gold Plus: $15.00 below $25,000).
steps.if: the funded or planned balance is below the opened account's ongoing minimum balance
steps.quote: Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).

steps.do: Tell the customer the Green Account (savings) requires paperless statements, needs at least $100 to open and $500 kept ongoing.
steps.if: the opened account_class is 'Green Account'/Green Account (savings)
steps.quote: Enroll in paperless statements, as indicated by Yes.

steps.do: Tell the customer the opened account's monthly ATM fee rebate cap from its own document (Gold Account up to $30 a month; Silver Plus Account up to 25; Silver Account up to 15).
steps.if: the customer said they need ATM fee rebates on savings
steps.quote: ATM fee rebate cap per month: $30

steps.do: Give the new account details and either the funding status or the funding deadline. If the customer also asked to close a checking account, continue with closing_personal_checking_accounts now (if they also asked to open a new checking account, do continue_open_checking first).
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

steps.do: Continue with opening_personal_checking_accounts for the checking class the customer chose, before any requested checking closure. Do not verify again.
steps.if: the customer also asked to open a new checking account in this conversation
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: If the customer also asked to close a savings account, continue with closing_personal_savings_accounts now (and closing_personal_checking_accounts after it, if requested). Use the new savings account_id as a destination only where the customer directs.
steps.if: the customer also asked to close a personal savings account
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged, the chosen savings account is open, and the customer has been told its funding status (the amount they asked for has been transferred) or the 30-day funding deadline with the opening deposit minimum, plus any monthly fee from being below the minimum balance (and the paperless requirement for a Green Account (savings), and the ATM rebate cap when the customer needs ATM rebates). Alternatively: if an eligibility check failed, the customer has been told which requirement is not met and what to resolve; if the opening failed, the customer has been told why and offered a transfer. If the customer also asked to open a new checking account, opening_personal_checking_accounts follows; if they asked to close a savings or checking account, the matching closure job follows after that.
